title: Kronecker Product Attention: Memory-Efficient KV Compression via Structured Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2610.12657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient autoregressive generation is increasingly limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, which grows linearly with sequence length, batch size, and model depth. Existing approaches such as Multi-Query Attention (MQA), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and Tensor Product Attention (TPA) reduce this cost through different trade-offs, but often sacrifice expressivity, require additional positional-encoding machinery, or impose restrictive low-rank structure. We propose Kronecker Product Attention (KPA), which represents key and value activations as sums of Kronecker products of compact, token-dependent matrix factors. KPA strictly generalizes TPA: rank-one vector-outer-product factorization arises as a degenerate Kronecker split, while non-degenerate matrix factors can represent richer block-structured patterns. translated_title: 克罗内克积注意力：基于结构化分解的内存高效KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 高效的自回归生成日益受到键值（KV）缓存内存占用的限制，该缓存随序列长度、批次大小和模型深度线性增长。现有方法如多查询注意力（MQA）、分组查询注意力（GQA）、多头潜在注意力（MLA）和张量积注意力（TPA）通过不同的权衡来降低这一成本，但往往牺牲了表达能力、需要额外的位置编码机制，或强加了限制性的低秩结构。我们提出克罗内克积注意力（KPA），它将键和值激活表示为紧凑的、依赖于词元的矩阵因子的克罗内克积之和。KPA严格推广了TPA：秩一向量外积分解作为一种退化的克罗内克分裂出现，而非退化的矩阵因子能够表示更丰富的块结构模式。我们进一步证明，与之匹配的结构化旋转位置编码算子……
tldr: 提出克罗内克积注意力（KPA），将键值激活表示为紧凑的词元相关矩阵因子的克罗内克积之和，严格推广了张量积注意力（TPA），在保持表达能力的同时实现了内存高效的KV缓存压缩。
en_tdlr: Proposes Kronecker Product Attention (KPA), which represents key and value activations as sums of Kronecker products of compact, token-dependent matrix factors, strictly generalizing Tensor Product Attention (TPA) to achieve memory-efficient KV cache compression without sacrificing expressivity.
